raw_answer_text:
Looking at the FigDown documentation and your flowchart requirements, I need to create a flowchart that documents the BGP session reset troubleshooting procedure. Since this is an experimental genre (flowchart), I'll use `figdown 0.1 flowchart`.

The flow you've described is:
1. Check interface error counters (process step)
2. Make a decision based on findings
3. Two branches: clear counters → monitor (if errors found) OR escalate to operator (if no errors)

Here's the finished FigDown document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

node checkcounters type=process "Check interface error counters"
node errorsfound type=decision "Errors found?"
node clearcounters type=process "Clear interface counters"
node monitor type=terminator "Monitor session"
node escalate type=terminator "Escalate to operator"

checkcounters -> errorsfound
errorsfound -> clearcounters label="yes"
clearcounters -> monitor
errorsfound -> escalate label="no"
```

This document follows FigDown's structure with:
- The spec provenance line (required first comment)
- Genre declaration: `figdown 0.1 flowchart` (experimental genre)
- The title: "BGP session reset procedure"
- Five nodes with their types (process, decision, terminator) and meaningful labels
- Four edges connecting them in the sequence you specified, with "yes"/"no" labels on the decision branches

The flowchart clearly shows the operator's troubleshooting path: check counters → decide → either clear and monitor or escalate.
